title: Development and characterization of novel T-cell receptor-like antibodies targeting human papillomavirus type 16 oncoprotein peptides for early cervical cancer detection using experimental and computational approaches.
authors: Sachit, Bassam Ali; Dass, Sylvia; Rajan, Rehasri Selva; Tye, Gee Jun; Balakrishnan, Venugopal
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和实验方法开发识别HPV16 E6/E7肽-MHC复合物的TCR样抗体，涉及蛋白-肽-MHC互作建模，但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Cervical cancer remains one of the most prevalent malignancies among women worldwide, with persistent infection by high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV), particularly types 16 and 18, as the principal etiological factor. The viral oncoproteins E6 and E7 are well-established drivers of cellular transformation and the maintenance of malignant phenotypes. This study aimed to generate T-cell receptor-like antibodies (TCR-like antibodies) capable of recognizing HPV16-derived E6 and E7 peptides presented by the major histocompatibility complex class I molecule HLA-A2402, with the goal of developing a diagnostic platform for early detection of HPV16-associated disease. Peptide-major histocompatibility complex (P-MHC) antigenic complexes were constructed and characterized using molecular docking, followed by experimental validation. A fully human domain antibody phage display library was screened against these complexes through iterative biopanning, supported by polyclonal and monoclonal enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA). Structural evaluation and binding affinity analyses were performed using molecular docking, Western blotting, TCR-like antibody ELISA, and cell-based ELISA. Two novel TCR-like antibodies, designated D2\Ab and A12\Ab, were identified and demonstrated strong and specific binding to HPV16 E6 and E7 P-MHC complexes, confirming high affinity and antigen specificity. Functional validation across multiple assays demonstrated selective recognition of target complexes without reactivity toward irrelevant controls. In conclusion, this study demonstrates the feasibility of generating fully human TCR-like antibodies for HPV-associated malignancies and highlights their potential application in early detection and targeted diagnostic strategies for cervical cancer.
abstract_zh: 宫颈癌仍然是全球女性中最常见的恶性肿瘤之一，高危型人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）的持续感染，尤其是16型和18型，是其主要病因。病毒癌蛋白E6和E7已被确认为细胞转化和恶性表型维持的关键驱动因子。本研究旨在生成能够识别由主要组织相容性复合体I类分子HLA-A2402呈递的HPV16来源E6和E7肽段的T细胞受体样抗体（TCR样抗体），以开发用于HPV16相关疾病早期检测的诊断平台。通过分子对接构建并表征了肽-主要组织相容性复合体（P-MHC）抗原复合物，随后进行了实验验证。利用全人源结构域抗体噬菌体展示文库，通过迭代生物淘选针对这些复合物进行筛选，并辅以多克隆和单克隆酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）。通过分子对接、Western blotting、TCR样抗体ELISA和细胞基ELISA进行了结构评估和结合亲和力分析。鉴定出两种新型TCR样抗体，命名为D2\Ab和A12\Ab，它们对HPV16 E6和E7 P-MHC复合物表现出强且特异的结合，确认了高亲和力和抗原特异性。多种检测方法的功能验证表明，它们能选择性识别靶标复合物，而对无关对照无反应。总之，本研究证明了生成针对HPV相关恶性肿瘤的全人源TCR样抗体的可行性，并强调了其在宫颈癌早期检测和靶向诊断策略中的潜在应用价值。
